author: Walt Disney Imagineering YouTube
text:
Zootopia: Hot Pursuit Ride-A-Long with Imagineers!
Buckle up, rookie—it's time to join the ZPD! Hop in with Imagineers as we ride along through Zootopia: Hot Pursuit at Shanghai Disneyland, the trackless dark ride where guests become honorary officers helping Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde crack the case.

✨ What makes this special?

🚗 Trackless ride vehicles move independently, spinning and darting through the chase in unpredictable, high-energy paths
📽️ Immersive media and projection blend seamlessly with physical sets to put guests right in the heart of Zootopia
🪄 Special effects heighten every twist and turn of the pursuit

🎥 Behind-the-Scenes with Imagineers
WED Walks and WED Rides allows you to learn more about our Disney attractions and experiences with the Imagineers who brought them to life!
